# Clientory - GEO for Professional Services
# https://clientory.org

> Clientory is a Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) monitoring platform
> for small professional service firms including law firms, accounting firms,
> consulting firms, and marketing agencies.

## Key Pages
- Homepage: https://clientory.org
- About: https://clientory.org/about
- GEO Guide: https://clientory.org/geo-for-professional-services
- Features: https://clientory.org/features
- Pricing: https://clientory.org/pricing
- Clientory App: https://app.clientory.org

## What We Do
Clientory tracks how often and how accurately AI platforms mention and recommend
professional service firms. Scans run today against ChatGPT and Claude on the
free report, plus Gemini on paid scans; Perplexity, Copilot, and other AI search
engines are on the roadmap.
The product has three parts:

1. AI Visibility Scanner — generates 5 prompts (free) or 25 (paid) from a firm's
   name, location, practice areas, and website; runs them across the supported
   models; returns a 0-100 visibility score, a per-prompt breakdown graded
   Positive / Passive / No mention, and a competitor gap showing which rival
   firms appear in prompts the firm is missing from. Paid scans re-run
   automatically every 7 days.
2. AI Presence Coach — a chat coach personalized to the firm's latest scan,
   covering score, competitor gaps, and specific recommendations. Paid only.
3. AI Citation Monitor — weekly snapshots tracking score over time, alerts when
   a new competitor enters the firm's prompts, and configurable email alerts on
   score changes.
